description: macOS 12 to 15 client SYN over Ethernet or Wi-Fi (MSS 1460)

provenance.notes: SYN traits attested by real traffic in the Zardaxt public database: layout MNWNNTSEE 93%, window 65535 95%, scale 6 87% (p0f's 4 for 10.9+ is out of date), TTL 64 99%, zero IP ID 92% (99% among canonical sessions; XNU ip_output.c sets it for DF packets), ECE+CWR set on the SYN in 67% of sessions (73% canonical, the rest send a plain SYN), timestamps always. ecn=true is the majority; the other 27-33% send a plain SYN. The shim sets the flags only on the SYN; a real Mac then marks data packets ECT, which is not shaped. Retransmits: XNU tcp_syn_backoff {1,1,1,1,1,2,4,8,...} times a base RTO assumed to be 1 s; the public data has no retransmit information. Timestamps: XNU tsval = t_ts_offset + tcp_now (random offset, 1 ms ticks), same as Linux. Capture a real Mac with `lb-fptest tcp-capture --flow` to settle the retransmit base.
